conviction_note: Unsigned size is set at 5.5%. Q4 is new but it is the low season, and the move is decided by two lines the release will carry for the first time: the group-wide booking status for winter 2026/27 and the dividend. I lean slightly negative (p_up 45) on a sourced pattern. The FactSet dividend consensus of 3.53 SEK sits above the board's +0.20 SEK-a-year steps, and the board has come in under the FactSet dividend at both of the last two year-ends. Against that, bookings should be the best in three year-ends. My sum was shrunk from -0.6 because the stock is already down 8% from its 26 August high with no sourced cause, so part of any disappointment may already be priced.

already_public.what: Winter 2026/27 bookings at group level +3% year on year (nights booked through SkiStar's accommodation agency) and 9M figures. Q3 operating profit 347 MSEK vs FactSet 309.
Non-regulatory Swedish press release: record summer events; Sälen winter bookings +10% year on year. Group figure NOT given. Stock +1.85% that day.
Snow-production capex of 306 MSEK, 489 new snow cannons, Tusenmetersliften rebuilt, 40 MSEK in Lindvallen: the 2026/27 investment plan is already out.

new_in_release.expect: Group booking status for winter 2026/27, SkiStar's only forward statement. I expect about +3% to +6%: up on June's +3% but below Sälen's +10%. It would be the best year-end reading in three years (+/-0% in 2024, -2% in 2025). Mildly positive, but it may read as a let-down against the '10%' headlines.
Proposed dividend: I expect 3.20-3.40 SEK against a FactSet consensus of 3.53. Lean negative.
Q4 (Jun-Aug) sales: I expect a miss against 276 MSEK, because there have been no property-development gains so far this year. Q4 operating profit around the -279 MSEK bar, sign unknown.
Comment on early-season bookings. The 2026/27 Christmas calendar is less favourable than 2025/26, which Nordea called optimal, while Easter 2027 falls early (28 March). Direction unknown.

findings.finding: The FactSet dividend consensus of 3.53 SEK (+18% year on year) sits above what the board has done. It has stepped the dividend +0.20 SEK a year (2.60, 2.80, 3.00) and paid 46% then 43% of earnings. At the last two year-ends it came in under FactSet: 2.80 vs 3.12 in 2024 and 3.00 vs 3.23 in 2025. On FY EPS of about 7.8, a 43% payout is about 3.35 and the step pattern gives 3.20.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both previous dividend misses came on down days: 2024-10-01 -2.97% and 2025-10-01 -4.76%, from the Yahoo daily tape. Both days also had flat or negative bookings, so the dividend's share of the fall cannot be separated out.
findings.original_quote: "I ordinarie utdelning föreslås 3,00 kronor per aktie (2,80). Väntat var 3,23." (2025: an ordinary dividend of 3.00 is proposed; 3.23 was expected.) 2024: "I ordinarie utdelning föreslås 2,80 kronor per aktie (2,60)... Det var lägre än analytikernas förväntningar vid 3,12 kronor." 2026 bar: "Årsutdelning (snitt), kronor 3,53 ... 3,00"
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus itself shows the sell-side has not adjusted: it sits at 3.53, higher again, after two straight misses. If the market had discounted it, the Swedish preview would carry a figure near 3.2-3.3. The yield impact is small (about 0.2 points of yield), so this is sized small.
findings.independence: The 2024 miss is a separate Finwire article (https://www.placera.se/telegram/skistars-resultat-blev-samre-an-vantat-i-fjarde-kvartalet-hojer-utdelningen-2024-10-01). The dividend history of 2.60/2.80/3.00 comes from the Yahoo dividend events feed (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SKIS-B.ST?range=10y&interval=1mo&events=div). Payout ratios of 46% and 43% are in the issuer's year-end releases (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b88515114714cf8f7aaae14b41f6abf7b&lang=sv&src=listed). Caveat: 3.53 is only 45% of FY EPS of about 7.8, inside the 40-60% policy, so a dividend meeting consensus is possible.

findings.finding: The group booking status for winter 2026/27 will be published for the first time since June's +3%. The only update since then was Sälen alone at +10%, in a Swedish-only, non-regulatory release that left out the group figure. So I expect the group between +3% and +6%: the strongest year-end reading in three years, but below the '10%' headlines.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Year-end booking readings: +/-0% (2024-10-01, stock -2.97%) and -2% (2025-10-01, -4.76%). June 2026's +3% came with an operating-profit beat and the stock rose 9.1%. The 17 Aug 2026 Sälen +10% release moved it +1.85%.
findings.original_quote: "Särskilt starkt är bokningsläget i Sälen, där antalet bokade objektsnätter i dagsläget ligger 10 procent över samma tidpunkt föregående år. I SkiStars senaste rapport, publicerad den 18 juni, redovisades en ökning på 3 procent i bokade objektsnätter för vintersäsongen 2026/27" (Bookings are particularly strong in Sälen, where nights booked are currently 10 percent above the same point last year. SkiStar's latest report, published 18 June, showed a 3 percent increase for winter 2026/27.)
findings.why_not_priced: Sälen +10% is public and was worth +1.85%. Since the 26 August high of 172.3 the stock has fallen to 159 (-7.7%) with no sourced cause, so the enthusiasm has largely unwound. What is not priced is the group number itself. Two things pull against the headline: the company chose to disclose only Sälen, and Nordea said 2025/26 had an 'optimal' Christmas calendar, which makes that part of the comparison hard. Early Easter 2027 pulls the other way. Net, a small positive.
findings.independence: Q3 release +3% group (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd3460c443e31657d2e451f82c60fa7fc&lang=sv&src=listed). Nordea's 2025 calendar note (https://www.placera.se/telegram/skistar-nordea-ser-optimal-kalender-for-skistar-bokningar-20250919): 'Nordea ser optimala förutsättningar för att nå rekordvolymer, eftersom kalendern ser gynnsam ut' (Nordea sees optimal conditions for record volumes because the calendar looks favourable), which describes the Christmas period now being compared against.

findings.finding: The Q4 sales consensus of 276 MSEK (+22% year on year) looks to assume property sales. Management said in June that the property market was still hesitant and that there had been no property-sale gains in the first nine months. Last year FactSet also overestimated Q4 sales (256 vs 226 actual) for the same reason.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-01: sales missed by 11.7% while operating profit beat by 7 MSEK. The stock fell 4.76%, but bookings and the dividend also disappointed that day, so this line cannot be isolated.
findings.original_quote: "Fastighetsmarknaden har varit fortsatt avvaktande under året. Under de tre första kvartalen har vi därför inte några redovisade realisationsvinster från fastighetsaffärer att jämföra med cirka 46 miljoner kronor under motsvarande period föregående räkenskapsår" (The property market has remained hesitant; no realised gains from property deals in the first three quarters, against about 46 MSEK a year earlier.)
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus still carries +50 MSEK of Q4 sales growth. Q4 is the low season, and the market reads it through the operating line, bookings and the dividend, so this is sized small. No property sale was announced June-August on the Nasdaq Nordic feed or in the press room.
findings.independence: Last year's sales miss for the same reason: https://www.placera.se/nyheter/skistar-rapporterar--mindre-rorelseforlust-an-vantat--hojer-utdelningen-2025-10-01 (sales 226 vs consensus 256). Nordea cut estimates in 2025 on 'en lägre exploateringsaktivitet' (lower property-development activity): https://www.placera.se/telegram/skistar-nordea-ser-optimal-kalender-for-skistar-bokningar-20250919

outside_window.finding: The upgraded snow guarantee with free cancellation early and late in the season ('Sveriges bästa snögaranti', Sweden's best snow guarantee) is a contingent cost if snow is poor in December 2026. It is not visible in this window.

baseline_tension: Mildly against the lean (+0.19, run-up mean reversion) and in line with the 20-day drift (-3.9%). Because the stock has already fallen 7.7% since 26 August, part of any disappointment may be priced, so the negative findings were cut by about 0.1 point from the draft.
language_note: The 17 Aug 2026 release giving Sälen bookings at +10% (and leaving out the group figure) was Swedish-only, on the /se/ press room. English searches surfaced only June's +3%, and one English search summary called the 10% a 2021 figure.
The bar that includes the dividend consensus (FactSet 3.53 SEK, sales 276, operating profit -279) came only from Swedish Finwire copy on Börsvärlden. No English preview was found.
The record of dividend misses at the last two year-ends (3.12 expected vs 2.80 paid; 3.23 vs 3.00) came only from Swedish Placera/Finwire result tables.
Nordea's 2025 'optimal kalender' booking note, which sets the Christmas comparison, came through Placera citing Dagens industri, in Swedish only.
Filings themselves added nothing: the issuer's releases and invitation are published in English and Swedish at the same time.
lessons_applied: Raised abs_move_pct from 4.5 to 5.5. The Q4 numbers and the group booking figure are not pre-released, and hunters understate the move by a median factor of about three. SkiStar's last four report-day moves had a median of 5.1%, so it was not pushed to the full 7% base because Q4 is the low season.

Treated the booking status as the guidance-equivalent line, where the move sits, and kept the dividend and Q4 sales findings small. Kept the booking finding small because Sälen +10% is already public, and a finding about a number already told is worth 0.

Moved p_up from 43 to 45 and cut the dividend finding from -0.8 to -0.7: the caveat that the recent drawdown may already price disappointment had to reach the number, and the negative sign rests on inference, not on a sourced unreleased figure.
